svg.title: Xinze-Li-Moqian: 2,065 GitHub contributions, 2025-10-27 to 2026-10-26
svg.desc: A 365-day isometric contribution calendar. Each tile is one day; column height uses the square root of its contribution count. Broken-out daily counts are available in each tile title.

g.text: 365 days · one tile per day · √count height scale
